site.name: PPI
site.tagline: What shops near you have in stock right now
site.description: Find a product in shops near you: who has it in stock, at what price, and how fresh that information is.

sync.title: Export folder
sync.intro: Open this page on the shop PC, in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome, and connect the folder your stock software exports to. While the page is open (minimised is fine) it checks the folder every 15 minutes and sends the newest stock file to PPI. PPI only reads that one folder and changes nothing on the PC.
sync.unsupported: Folder connection works only in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome on a computer. This browser (for example Firefox or Safari) cannot do it. Open this page in Edge or Chrome on the shop PC.
sync.no_shop: Add your shop first under “My shop”.
sync.allow_hint: After the PC restarts, the browser asks once more. Choose “Allow on every visit” so it does not ask again.
sync.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again on this PC, then reopen this page.
sync.other_window: PPI is already watching this folder in another window or tab. This one takes over when the other one is closed.
sync.no_file: No stock file in this folder yet (XML, CSV, TXT or XLSX).
sync.settling: The newest file was written less than a minute ago. It is sent as soon as the export is finished.
sync.up_to_date: The newest file has already been sent.
sync.send_failed: Sending failed: {error}. PPI tries again at the next check.
sync.result_updated: Stock sent. Items updated: {items}; set to out of stock (missing from the file): {zeroed}.
sync.result_unchanged: This file had already been sent.
sync.result_proposed: File received (rows: {rows}). Now check its columns once under My shop → Stock file columns and approve them; after that your stock appears automatically.
sync.result_waiting_for_approval: File received (rows: {rows}). Waiting for you to approve its columns under My shop.
sync.result_layout_changed: The file’s layout has changed (rows: {rows}). Your previous stock stays visible until you approve the new columns under My shop.
sync.result_error: The file could not be read: {error}
sync.picker_failed: The folder could not be opened: {error}
sync.install_intro: Install PPI as an app, then let it start with Windows, so the folder is checked even after a restart.
sync.installed: You are using the installed PPI app.
sync.install_manual: No button? In Edge: menu (⋯) → Apps → Install this site as an app. In Chrome: menu (⋮) → Cast, save and share → Install page as app.
sync.autostart_title: Open PPI automatically when Windows starts:
sync.autostart_1: Start → All apps → right-click “PPI” → More → Open file location.
sync.autostart_2: Select the “PPI” shortcut and copy it (Ctrl+C).
sync.autostart_3: Press Windows+R, type shell:startup and press Enter.
sync.autostart_4: Paste the shortcut into the folder that opens (Ctrl+V).
sync.keep_awake: The PC must not go to sleep during opening hours: Settings → System → Power → Sleep: Never.

owner.state_confirmed: Approved – new files are applied automatically.
owner.columns_saved: Columns approved. The PPI window on the shop PC sends the file again at its next check (or click “Check now” there).

owner.error_limit: An account can have at most 5 shops.
owner.error_columns: Item code, name, quantity and price must each be a column of your file.
owner.export_rules_title: Rules for the export from your stock software
owner.rule_folder: A folder used only for this, e.g. C:\Export. PPI sends the newest file in it.
owner.rule_format: XML, CSV (UTF-8 or Windows-1250, separated by ; or ,) or Excel .xlsx – not the old .xls.
owner.rule_columns: Columns: item code, item name, quantity in stock, selling price incl. VAT; EAN and brand if available.
owner.rule_all: All items in one file, always the same file name, overwritten each time. An item missing from the file counts as sold out.
owner.rule_schedule: Every 15–30 minutes during opening hours, plus once at night.
owner.rule_public: Only public information: no purchase prices, suppliers or customer data.
owner.rule_pc: The PC stays on during opening hours with this page or the PPI app open (minimised is fine).
owner.error_translation: Enter at least one translation (up to 300 characters).
owner.error_plan_active: This shop has a paid plan that still renews. Cancel it first under Plan → Manage subscription.

owner.error_no_plan: This is part of the paid plan.
owner.private_columns_note: Columns you don't choose here (e.g. purchase price, supplier, margin) are private: never shown anywhere and never sent to the assistant.
owner.delete_summary: Removes the shop from PPI for good
owner.error_booking: Enter the web address of your booking page, e.g. https://reservio.com/yourshop.

owner.error_special_ranges: Enter a time from – to (e.g. 8:00 – 12:00) or choose Closed all day.

privacy_assistant.title: Privacy in the shop assistant
privacy_assistant.draft: Draft text – the final wording is being prepared.
privacy_assistant.what: If the shop has the Pro plan, every conversation with its assistant is stored: your messages, the assistant's answers with the items it showed you (name, price and availability at that moment) and the files you send. Location data (GPS) is removed from photos. Access keys are never stored in the conversation.
privacy_assistant.who: Only the owners of this shop, in My shop. Other shops and visitors cannot see it.
privacy_assistant.time: A conversation ends after 30 minutes without a message or when you close the chat. The shop keeps it for 30, 90 or 365 days (its own setting, 90 days if not set); then it is deleted with its files.
privacy_assistant.delete: While the chat is open, you can delete the conversation and files with “Delete my conversation”. Later, please ask the shop directly.

cloud.title: Cloud folder
cloud.intro: Every finished conversation of the assistant is saved to your OneDrive or Dropbox: the conversation's PDF and the shopper's files.
cloud.needs_plan: The cloud folder is part of the Pro plan.
cloud.unavailable: The cloud folder is not switched on yet (database update 23).
cloud.folder_hint: If the folder does not exist, we create it.
cloud.structure: Each conversation gets its own folder: {folder}/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM_id/ with konverzacia.pdf and a subory folder.
cloud.share_link: A share link (e.g. 1drv.ms, onedrive.live.com or dropbox.com/scl/…) is not enough: a folder usually cannot be written to through a share link. Connect OneDrive or Dropbox with the button below instead and enter the folder as a path, e.g. /Cacadoo/Shop.
cloud.permission_onedrive: OneDrive: Microsoft asks to “read and write your files”; it has no narrower permission for one folder. PPI works only in the folder you choose.
cloud.permission_dropbox: Dropbox: create folders, upload files and list them (so nothing is saved twice).
cloud.permission_common: We never overwrite or delete anything: a new file with the same name gets a number, e.g. “(2)”. Access is stored encrypted and “Disconnect” deletes it.
cloud.status_expired: The cloud connection has expired – connect it again
cloud.failing_since: Saving has been failing since {when}. If it goes on for 24 hours, we will e-mail you.
cloud.folder_failed: The folders could not be loaded. Try again.
cloud.backfill_intro: Uploads, once, the conversations of the chosen period that are not in the cloud yet.
cloud.disconnect_confirm: Yes, disconnect the cloud. Files already in the cloud stay there.
cloud.disconnect_microsoft: You can also remove the permission in your Microsoft account (Apps and services).
cloud.ok_connected: The cloud is connected. Conversations will be saved automatically.
cloud.ok_disconnected: The cloud is disconnected and the access deleted.
cloud.ok_backfill: Conversations waiting to be saved to the cloud: {n}.
cloud.ok_retry: We will try to save the conversation again.
cloud.error_denied: You did not confirm the connection. Try again.
cloud.error_failed: The connection did not work. Try again.
cloud.error_failed_why: The connection did not work (code {why}). Try again; if it happens again, send this code to whoever set up PPI.
cloud.error_app_dropbox: Dropbox refused the app's secret. In Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets set DROPBOX_APP_SECRET to the "App secret" from dropbox.com/developers/apps → your app → Settings (Show), then connect again.
cloud.error_app_onedrive: Microsoft refused the app's secret (it may have expired). In Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets set ONEDRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET to the "Value" of a new client secret (Microsoft Entra → App registrations → Certificates & secrets), then connect again.
cloud.error_scope_dropbox: The Dropbox app lacks a permission (writing files). dropbox.com/developers/apps → your app → Permissions → tick files.metadata.read and files.content.write → Submit. Then Connect Dropbox again and Allow.
cloud.error_scope_onedrive: The OneDrive app lacks a permission. In Microsoft Entra → App registrations → API permissions add Files.ReadWrite and offline_access, then Connect OneDrive again.
cloud.error_platform_onedrive: Microsoft refused the sign-in: the redirect address must be under the "Web" platform. Microsoft Entra → App registrations → Cacadoo PPI → Authentication: remove …/cloud-export/oauth/onedrive from "Single-page application" (or "Mobile and desktop"), add it with Add a platform → Web, set "Allow public client flows" to No → Save. Then Connect OneDrive again.
cloud.error_audience_onedrive: The Microsoft app does not let in this kind of account. Microsoft Entra → App registrations → Cacadoo PPI → Authentication → Supported account types: "Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts" → Save. Then Connect OneDrive again.
cloud.error_folder: This folder cannot be used (a file with the same name is in the path). Choose another one.
cloud.error_not_configured: The cloud connection is not set up yet (the app keys are missing in Supabase).
cloud.error_no_plan: The cloud folder is part of the Pro plan.
cloud.error_expired: The cloud connection has expired – connect it again
cloud.error_cloud: The cloud is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
cloud.error_fn_missing: Supabase has no function cloud-export: Edge Functions → Deploy a new function → name exactly cloud-export → paste the whole file → Deploy.
cloud.error_fn_jwt: Supabase lets calls reach cloud-export only with "Verify JWT" off: Edge Functions → cloud-export → switch off Verify JWT → Save.
cloud.error_fn_boot: The function cloud-export did not start: paste the whole file supabase/functions/cloud-export/index.ts into it again → Deploy (its Logs say why).
cloud.error_fn_limit: The function cloud-export has too few resources right now. Try again in a moment.

domains.own_intro: Connect a domain you already own – no domain fee. You need the Pro plan.
domains.own_needs_pro: You can connect your own domain with the Pro plan.
domains.own_in_use: Another shop already uses this domain.
domains.dns_title: Log in at your registrar and add these records
domains.mx_warning: Do not delete the existing MX records, or your e-mail stops working.
domains.auto_dns: The domain is at Websupport in our account – we set the records ourselves.
domains.check_too_soon: You can check again in a moment.
domains.disconnect_confirm: Yes, disconnect (the website runs on its Cacadoo address again)
domains.error: That did not work. Try again.
domains.findable_title: Get found on Google and by AI assistants
domains.findable_intro: The site on {domain} has its own sitemap.xml, robots.txt and llms.txt. Verify it with Google here and add your product categories.
domains.google_step1: Open Google Search Console, click Add property, choose Domain and enter {domain}.
domains.google_step2: Google shows a TXT record that starts with “google-site-verification=”. Copy it and paste it here.
domains.google_step3: Then click Verify in Search Console.
domains.google_auto_note: Cacadoo writes the record into your domain's DNS itself. Other records (e-mail MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and other TXT) are never changed or removed.
domains.google_manual_note: Your registrar runs this domain: we show you the record and you add it there.
domains.google_added: The TXT record is in the DNS of {domain}. Click Verify in Search Console (a DNS change can take a few minutes to show).
domains.google_manual: Add this record for {domain} at your registrar, then click Verify in Search Console:
domains.google_manual_keep: Do not change or remove existing records (especially MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC), or e-mail may stop working.
domains.google_invalid: This is not the TXT value from Search Console. Copy the whole record that starts with “google-site-verification=”.
domains.google_too_many: The domain already has 5 Google verification records. Write to us if you need another one.
domains.google_too_soon: Wait a moment and try again.
domains.sitemap_step1: Once the domain is verified in Search Console, open Sitemaps in the menu on the left.
domains.sitemap_step2: Type sitemap.xml into Add a new sitemap and click Submit.
domains.sitemap_step3: Google then reads the pages of all your products regularly by itself.
domains.ai_text: llms.txt describes your shop for AI assistants: name, address, opening hours, categories, the sitemap and how to read the stock. robots.txt lets search engines and AI assistants read the public pages — never My shop, private folders or content behind an access key.
domains.categories_hint: Separate them with commas. At most 12, each at most 40 characters, for example: Groceries, Drugstore, Coffee.
domains.categories_error: The categories could not be saved: at most 12, each at most 40 characters.
domains.indexnow_title: Faster in Bing and other search engines (IndexNow)
domains.indexnow_text: After every stock upload we tell Bing, Seznam, Yandex and others which products changed — at most once per upload and only the changed pages. Nothing to set up.
domains.indexnow_failed: Last time ({time}) the search engine answered: {result}. We try again with the next stock upload.
domains.indexnow_none: Nothing announced yet: it happens with the next stock upload that changes something.

admin_domains.volume: Websupport gives volume discounts from 30, 50 and 100 domains.
admin_domains.credit_unknown: The credit has not been checked yet.
admin_domains.credit_low: The credit is under the limit of {limit} € – top it up at Websupport.
admin_domains.same_price: Domain price = Websupport's price list (shops see "The domain costs the same as on Websupport.sk"; you keep the table's prices equal)
admin_domains.low_credit: Warn when the credit is under (€)
admin_domains.test_domain: Test domain for REGISTRAR_MODE=test (a whole domain in your Websupport account)
admin_domains.prices_note: Shops see and pay these prices. Websupport's purchase (partner) price is never shown to shops.
admin_domains.limits_hint: How many PDF sections a shop may have, and how many pages and MB one PDF may have. Applies at once; sections already uploaded stay, those over the number are hidden.
admin_domains.limits_unavailable: The limits will be available after database update 30.
admin_domains.holidays_note: Public holidays per country. The library's rows come from scripts/holidays.mjs; your changes always win over them and the script never overwrites them. Struck through = does not count.
admin_domains.holiday_closed_from: Closed from (only when shops must close)

holidays.auto_text: On: on public holidays the shop shows the holiday or the closure required by law. Off: your regular opening hours apply on holidays too (e.g. a pharmacy, a petrol station, a shop that is always open).
holidays.range2: Second time (e.g. after a lunch break, optional)
holidays.holidays_none: No public holiday in the next 60 days.
holidays.kind_day_off: public day off – shops may open
holidays.auto_off_note: Automatic holidays are off: your regular opening hours apply on holidays (special days still apply).
holidays.unavailable: This part becomes available after database update 27.
holidays.special_deleted_many: The selected special days were deleted.

sections.title: Page sections (PDF)
sections.intro: Add your own PDFs or pictures to the shop page – news, a leaflet, a menu, information about the shop. Visitors see them as pages (a slider or one under another); search engines read the text too, and with Pro the shop's AI assistant.
sections.unavailable: This part becomes available after database update 28.
sections.pro_only: Page sections are part of the Pro plan.
sections.plan_ended: The Pro plan has ended: only the first section in the order is shown, the others are hidden (not deleted). They come back with Pro – or change the order or delete sections.
sections.title_hint: E.g. October news, About us, Leaflet, Menu
sections.layout_hint: Slider: one page at a time, swipe or use the arrows. One under another: all pages one below the other.
sections.position_end: At the end of the page
sections.format_hint: Recommended: A4 portrait (210 × 297 mm), text at least 11 pt, pictures at least 150 dpi, at most {pages} pages and {mb} MB. For reading on a phone, 1 page = 1 topic works best. A4 landscape is possible, but the text will be smaller on a phone.
sections.pictures_hint: Pictures are fine too: instead of a PDF you can upload photos or pictures (JPG, PNG, WebP) – each picture becomes one page, in the order of their file names. The AI reads the text in the pictures for search engines and screen readers. Only a PDF can be downloaded.
sections.replace_title: New PDF or pictures for the section “{title}”
sections.replace_hint: The new PDF or pictures replace the old ones; the section's name, settings and order stay. While the new ones are being prepared, visitors see the old ones.
sections.reading_ai: The AI is reading pages without text ({n})…
sections.done: Done. Check the preview and publish the section.
sections.removed: For safety we removed scripts, actions or embedded files from the PDF.
sections.delete_confirm: Delete the section “{title}” with its PDF, pictures and text?
sections.state_processing: The new PDF is being prepared…
sections.limit_reached: You have {max} sections – no more can be added.
sections.upgrade_more: For more sections, switch to Pro
sections.upgrade_pages: For more pages, switch to Pro.
sections.free_position: On a free profile, sections are shown after the opening hours, before the shop's items.
sections.state_over_limit_free: Hidden – a free profile shows at most {max} (the first in the order). For more sections, switch to Pro.
sections.state_over_limit_pro: Hidden – over the number of sections ({max})
sections.error_not_pdf: This is not a PDF or a picture (JPG, PNG, WebP).
sections.error_too_big: A file may have at most {mb} MB.
sections.error_mixed: Choose one PDF or pictures – not both at once.
sections.error_picture: The picture “{name}” cannot be opened. Use JPG, PNG or WebP.
sections.error_too_many_pictures: At most {pages} pictures – each picture is one page.
sections.error_pictures_unavailable: Pictures can be uploaded after database update 31.
sections.error_too_many_pages: A PDF may have at most {pages} pages.
sections.error_encrypted: The PDF is protected by a password or encrypted. Save it without a password and try again.
sections.error_unclean: The PDF could not be cleaned safely, so we cannot use it.
sections.error_no_plan: Page sections are part of the Pro plan.
sections.error_dates: The “until” date must be the same as or later than the “from” date.
sections.error_limit: You have reached the largest number of sections.
sections.error_limits: The PDF has more pages or MB than your profile allows.
sections.error_pixels: A page picture could not be made. Try Chrome or Edge.
sections.error_type: A page picture could not be made. Try Chrome or Edge.
sections.error_incomplete: Some pages were not uploaded. Upload the PDF again.
sections.error_version: Another PDF started uploading in the meantime. Reload the page.
sections.preview_note: Only you see the preview. Visitors see the section once it is published (and within its dates).
sections.preview_none: This section has no PDF yet.
sections.site_logo_intro: A small logo at the top left of your website on your own domain; a click takes the visitor back to the start (or to the logo link below). SK · HU · EN is on the right. The shop's name and logo are on the page above its details.
sections.site_logo_hint: Good pictures: PNG or WebP with a transparent background (JPG works too), a wide or square logo, at least 120 px high. We make it 120 px high (at most 600 px wide); in the header it is 40 px high. Without one, the shop's logo is used.
sections.site_logo_only_pro: Only with the Pro plan or a domain of your own.
sections.error_site_logo: The logo could not be used. Try PNG, WebP or JPG.
sections.site_logo_link_hint: Where a click on the logo leads, for example your main website (https://…). It opens in the same window. Empty = the home page of this website.
sections.site_logo_link_home: The logo leads to the website's home page.
sections.ok_site_logo_link_removed: The logo leads to the home page again.
sections.error_site_logo_link: The link is not valid. Enter the full address of a website, starting with https://.
sections.error_site_logo_no_plan: Only with the Pro plan or a domain of your own.
sections.error_no_file: Choose a PDF or pictures first.

conv_folder.title: Conversations to this computer
conv_folder.intro: Every finished conversation with the assistant is saved by itself as a PDF (with the shopper's pictures) into a folder on this computer – every 5 minutes while this page is open. Nothing there is ever replaced or deleted. Works in Edge and Chrome on a computer.
conv_folder.summary: Each finished conversation's PDF into a folder on this computer
conv_folder.allow_hint: After a restart the browser asks again whether PPI may write to the folder.
conv_folder.older_done: Older conversations are being saved too (files already in the folder stay as they are).
conv_folder.result_waiting: A conversation has ended and its PDF is still being made – it is saved at the next check.
conv_folder.result_error: Saving did not work: {error}. It is tried again at the next check.
conv_folder.picker_failed: The folder could not be chosen: {error}
conv_folder.other_window: Another PPI window already saves this shop's conversations. This window takes over when that one closes.
conv_folder.unsupported: Saving to a folder works only in Edge or Chrome on a computer. You can download conversations in AI assistant → Assistant conversations (Download PDF).
